title: Neo-Expressionism Meets Cyberpunk
subtitle: Animated graphic design merging aggressive expressionist brushwork with sci-fi motifs
seo_title: Neo-Expressionism Cyberpunk Abstract — Animated Graphic Design
seo_description: An animated generative art collection merging raw neo-expressionism with cyberpunk aesthetics, edited with LumaFusion.
thumb_alt: Animated artwork showing twin subjects combining cyberpunk neon elements with chaotic expressionist strokes
img_alt: Detail views of animated neo-expressionist cyberpunk composites
challenge: Fusing two heavily contrasting aesthetics—the neon, high-tech gloss of cyberpunk and the aggressive, analog chaos of neo-expressionism—into a harmonious, animated visual piece.
approach: Generated baseline keyframes prioritizing thick, chaotic oil textures but structured the prompts around sci-fi compositions. The assets were then sequenced and animated dynamically using LumaFusion to introduce pulsing, glitch-like digital movement over analog textures.
result: A unique, tension-filled digital short, "The Trouble With Twins & Meeting The Architect," providing a fresh stylistic take on sci-fi art and expanding the boundaries of AI animation.
